Counsel for Applicant :- O.P. Tiwari,Smriti Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.

1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2. None appears for the respondent complainant despite service of notice.
3.
In terms of the F.I.R. registered on 26.8.2023, it was alleged that the daughter of the informant aged about 17 years was enticed away by the applicant on the false pretext of marriage, on 23.8.2023.
It was stated that the daughter of the informant had returned back on 24.8.2023.
The statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C. was recorded wherein the victim stated that she was threatened to sit on a motorcycle and was taken on a motorcycle and wrong was committed on her.

A somewhat similar statement was given under Section 164 Cr.P.C.
4.
In the light of the said allegation, learned counsel for the applicant argued that the F.I.R. was Dharmendra Lodhi vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home, ...

1 registered after substantial delay.

She further drawn my attention to the medical report on record which was done on 28.8.2023 wherein the statement of the victim was recorded that she was undergoing mensuration periods and last mensuration period was 21.8.2023 which if co related with the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. clearly becomes wrong as she alleged that the rape was committed during the said period which is not possible.
Hence, the applicant who is languishing in jail since 1.9.2023 having no criminal history, hence the applicant may be enlarged on bail.
4. Learned A.G.A. also opposed the prayer for bail.

5. Considering the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. coupled with the fact that there is delay in lodging the F.I.R. and the applicant having no criminal antecedents is languishing in custody since 1.9.2023 and there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the applicant if enlarged on bail, would in any way adversely affect the trial and without expressing any opinion on merit, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
6. Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Dharmendra Lodhi be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No.392 of 2023,
under Sections 363, 366, 376, 323 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of the POCSO Act and Section 3(2) (v) of the SC & ST Act, Police Station Purwa, District Unnao on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions :-
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 15.7.2024 Shukla  Dharmendra Lodhi vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home, ... on 15 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/26137252/
